properties.title: Flood Advisory issued November 27 at 8:09AM PST until November 28 at 8:00PM PST by NWS Sacramento CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Coastal Flooding from abnormally high tides.

* WHERE...Low-lying areas along the Sacramento River, San Joaquin
River, and other Delta waterways in Solano, Yolo, Sacramento, and
San Joaquin Counties.

* WHEN...Until 800 PM PST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of low-lying areas including parks, lots,
roads, marshes, and vulnerable islands. Erosion along levees is
possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 801 AM PST, NWS meteorologists have determined that
abnormally high tides will result in Coastal Flooding.
- The highest tides each day are forecast as follows (all times
local). MHHW is Mean Higher High Water, or the average
highest daily tide; MLLW is Mean Lower Low Water, or the
average lowest daily tide.
* Port Chicago: +2.2 ft MHHW (7.1 ft MLLW) at 2:45 PM Fri
11/27, +1.7 ft MHHW (6.6 ft MLLW) at 3:44 PM Sat 11/28, +1.2
ft MHHW (6.1 ft MLLW) at 4:53 PM Sun 11/29, and +0.7 ft MHHW
(5.6 ft MLLW) at 7:25 AM Mon 11/30.
* West Sacramento: +2.1 ft MHHW (6.5 ft MLLW) at 6:02 PM Fri
11/27, +1.8 ft MHHW (6.2 ft MLLW) at 6:59 PM Sat 11/28, +1.4
ft MHHW (5.8 ft MLLW) at 8:03 PM Sun 11/29, and +1.0 ft MHHW
(5.4 ft MLLW) at 9:18 PM Mon 11/30.
* Rio Vista (Datum NAVD88): +7.5 ft at 5:00 PM Fri 11/27,
+7.4 ft at 6:00 PM Sat 11/28, +7.1 ft at 7:00 PM Sun 11/29,
+6.8 ft at 9:00 AM Mon 11/30, and +5.9 ft at 10:00 PM Tue
12/01.
- These predictions include up to +1.5 feet of storm surge that
will enhance the astronomical tide and flooding threat.
Timing of high tide may vary by several hours throughout the
San Francisco Bay and Delta.
- Real-time water levels and latest forecasts are available at:
* Port Chicago: https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/noaatidepre
dictions.html?id=9415144
* West Sacramento: https://tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/noaatide
predictions.html?id=9416131
* Rio Vista: https://water.noaa.gov/gauges/RVBC1
properties.instruction:
Some roads that are commonly dry may become inundated during high
tide. If you encounter flooded roadways: turn around, dont drown.

properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Norton has issued a Flood Warning
for the following rivers in Massachusetts...

Taunton River Near Bridgewater affecting Bristol and Plymouth
Counties.

For the Taunton River...including Bridgewater...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Taunton River near Bridgewater.

* WHEN...From this afternoon to late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 8.0 feet, Backwater flooding from the Taunton River
will cause flooding of lower Purchade Brook in Middleboro.  This
will cause Woloski Park to become impassable by most vehicles.
Beware of the dangers of crossing flooded roadways.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:45 AM EST Friday the stage was 7.3 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage just
after midnight tonight to a crest of 8.5 feet early tomorrow
afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage Sunday evening.
- Flood stage is 8.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. Most flood related deaths occur
in automobiles. Do not attempt to cross water covered bridges, dips,
or low water crossings. Never try to cross a flowing stream, even a
small one, on foot. To escape rising water find another route over
higher ground.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.
